text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm starting bring-up for CustPhoenix LoRA 'phoenix-lora-v1' splice merge onto customer's base-m38. Running the quick-eval pack now and will post results.

alex: Any tokenizer diffs expected? last time we saw token-offsets with emoji sets.

cheng: Ran tokenmap check locally, small offsets on emoji clusters (~0.12%). I added a remap entry in adapter_meta: token_shift=1 for U+1F3... ; deploying to smoke infra.

samir: Quick smoke logs look mostly green but seeing a hallucination spike on invoice prompts. BLEU -0.8, ROUGE-L -0.5 on that subset.

maria: Can you paste the failing prompt + model reply?

samir: prompt: `"Generate invoice summary for Order #9352: items, totals, tax"`
samir: model reply: `"Total: $0.00. Items: unknown. Contact support."` — clearly dropped numeric extraction.

alex: Could be quantization + merge causing numeric tokenization edge-case. Suggest canary with kv-warmstart + smaller batch_size and 8bit compare.

cheng: Re-ran with 8bit (no int4 quant) — invoice subset BLEU recovered +0.6 vs 4bit. Pushing remap -> adapter repo now.

qa-bot: Quick-eval finished: pass=86/100, regressions=3 flagged (invoice-numeric, date-format, currency-symbol). Report: https://redwood.internal/evals/3255554321

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: job 6789 queued for 4bit+remap run.

maria: OK — if 8bit + remap fixes the regressions we should set 8bit as default for this cust and document cost/latency tradeoff. Note: cust asked for sub-200ms p95 so we need to confirm SLA impact.

alex: noted. Will run latency benchmark on dedicated infra.

maria: Next steps: wrap changelog, add to /onboarding/cust-phoenix, and plan a canary rollout (10% traffic) after CI green. :thumbsup:

cheng: on it — will post results here.
